verdict.rationale: The product has no hosted data store to escape. The installer writes skills into your repo as ordinary, editable files you own (SKILL.md markdown), the set is MIT-licensed and works with any agent, and project artifacts such as issues can live as local markdown. A hands-on install confirmed plain SKILL.md files landing in ./.claude/skills/. missing for 10: explicit documentation of offboarding or uninstall, clarity on portability when using the read-only managed plugin route or GitHub/Linear trackers, and independent corroboration of lock-in-free exit.
